qrRules.statement: QR товара ссылается на конкретную seller store_offer, не на голый SKU
Только PUBLISHED store + offer + CATALOG PRODUCT допускают публичную покупку
Публичная карточка доступна без входа; личные сделки/заказы — после buyer proof
Цена/валюта с сервера; браузерная цена не authoritative
Изменение цены/фотографий не меняет стабильный публичный QR
Отзыв/ротация QR не переписывает ранее созданные заказы
Публичные FILES показываются лишь после owner publication + CLEAN/AVAILABLE/approved variant
Private original и EXIF/location не публиковать
Продукт может иметь безопасный placeholder при отсутствии фото
Locale kk/ru/en/zh-Hans, fallback к source_locale обозначается
R1 quantity — integer 1..1000 per merged offer line
Unit of measure не подменяет правила integer quantity
Видимое наличие — indicative, не заказанный резерв
Поиск KATO exact match до подтверждения complete hierarchy
Разные продавцы и SKU не суммируются в публичное наличие
Наличие по региону ≠ обещание доставки
BUY_AT_LIST_PRICE использует price acknowledgement / version contract, не silent repricing
Email-first PLACED не доказывает завершённую идентификацию покупателя
Повторный checkout same tenant+key+fingerprint создаёт максимум один заказ
Цена клиента после торга не изменяет STOREFRONT public price
Proposal фиксирует buyer, seller offer, qty, unit price, currency, expiry, revision
Ответить на последнюю ревизию может только противоположная сторона
Согласованная цена не создаёт автоматически заказ
AcceptedQuote может быть consumed не более одного раза
Negotiated order содержит immutable quote source и accepted agreed price
AcceptedQuote checkout соблюдает pending_email_identity_id и buyer ownership
Никакой reservation при PLACED или торге
CONFIRMED резервирует full lines на одном tenant ACTIVE WAREHOUSE
warehouse origin KATO/address/GPS фиксируется только при первом CONFIRMED
Исторический origin никогда не перезаписывается после редактирования склада
Старым CONFIRMED без origin не присваивать выдуманные координаты
PREPARING и READY не изменяют on_hand и не списывают reserved
READY разрешён только при всех полных ACTIVE reservations на выбранном складе
ORDER_REFERENCE допускает лишь authenticated owner/staff lookup
PICKUP_CREDENTIAL выпускается только verified buyer/delegate при READY
Raw pickup secret нигде не сохраняется и не логируется
Expired/revoked/consumed proof нельзя выполнить
Сканирование/preview не потребляют credential и не списывают товар
Handover требует свежих IAM grants, warehouse scope и explicit staff confirmation
Один successful handover = один receipt, один COMPLETED и один set stock movements
Failed handover откатывает весь cross-domain transaction
Два concurrent scans не создают второе списание
Истечение QR не отменяет заказ и не освобождает резерв
No-show из READY остаётся отдельным неутверждённым workflow
После handover RMA создаётся отдельно, original COMPLETED не изменяется
Return qty ≤ ранее выданному minus уже принятому возврату
Возврат без inspection не увеличивает sellable on_hand
Повреждённое/карантинное не создаёт доступный для продажи stock
SERVICE не отправлять в PRODUCT inventory reserve/fulfill
QR payment/refund/courier delivery нельзя считать доказанными из COMPLETED склада

coreScenarios.expected: An active warehouse cannot be deactivated after reserved stock commits
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Разделить INACTIVE с остатком и CLOSED без остатка; нормативное расхождение §12.3.

coreScenarios.expected: Deactivation first prevents later stock reservation
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Дополнить остальные пары transfer/confirm/close из того же класса; сохранить остаток при законной деактивации.

coreScenarios.expected: Published product SKU and price are tenant qualified
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Дополнить точные price/quantity bounds, invalid currency и negative zero-effect oracles.

coreScenarios.expected: Catalog version CAS prevents stale price revision and cross tenant write
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Catalog CAS сам по себе не доказывает коммерческую цену; проверить обе истории и old-order hash при drift.

coreScenarios.expected: Active sellable SKU cannot be archived across concurrent offers
coreScenarios.openRequirement: В том же классе есть receipt-first; stocktake race и обе стороны всех конфликтов требуют отдельной привязки.

coreScenarios.expected: Seller storefront publish pause resume preserve revision and audit
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Resume выполняется publish с актуальной версией; отдельно revoked role, inactive workspace и tenant.

coreScenarios.expected: Offer authoritative price version and accepted order snapshot are consistent
coreScenarios.openRequirement: У price update CAS/no-op, а не универсальный request-key receipt; привязать hide и invalid product.

coreScenarios.expected: Paused storefront cannot accept new checkout
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Оба теста кандидаты; доказать именно publication и оба управляемых порядка pause × checkout.

coreScenarios.expected: Single seller checkout uses immutable accepted price and SKU snapshot
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Сквозной happy path из старой карты не доказывает конфликт ключа; отдельно lost response и process restart.

coreScenarios.expected: Price/pause change×checkout both orders → acknowledged version or reconfirm, no new order on deny
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Старая привязка к duplicate checkout не покрывает stale price/pause; отдельно verified QR и обычный route.

coreScenarios.expected: Full reserve only after seller confirmation
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Кандидаты вызывают внутренние методы; нужен verified facade, multi-line snapshot и один склад в strict mode.

coreScenarios.expected: Insufficient stock rolls back all reservations and status
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Shortage/outer rollback не равны hard crash; подтвердить last-line failure и отсутствие всех success-эффектов.

coreScenarios.expected: Two orders compete for last units and reversed SKU ordering → no oversell/deadlock leak
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Deterministic hot-SKU A/B winner schedules with exact insufficient inventory denial, replay and multi-line rollback; PostgreSQL execution and strict warehouse scope variants pending.

coreScenarios.expected: Cancel×confirm and cancel×fulfill both orders → one valid final state/release/debit
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Four deterministic STANDARD order cancel/confirm and cancel/fulfill commit orders, exact loser denial and terminal replay; strict pickup route and durable SQL artifacts remain open.

coreScenarios.expected: Cancellation before pick releases once and retries idempotently
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Есть последовательный picked-deny; не найден самостоятельный детерминированный pick × cancel в обоих порядках.

coreScenarios.expected: Proof-required QR order cannot use generic fulfillment
coreScenarios.openRequirement: SQL fixture proof-mode допустим для локального fence; полный путь должен создавать mode через verified QR checkout.

coreScenarios.expected: Generic fulfill×secure pickup both orders → exactly one legal debit with proof
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Strict QR list-price generic-first rollback and negotiated-price pickup-first commit schedules implemented with actual PostgreSQL blocking-edge verification, exact route denial and joined receipt/credential/reservation/movement/event SQL oracle; new exact-SHA execution and persisted variant SQL artifacts pending.

coreScenarios.expected: Warehouse grants A not B; revoke × each confirm/prepare/fulfill both orders
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Старая привязка к picked cancel неверна; квалифицировать strict flag и оба revoke orders для каждой операции.

coreScenarios.expected: Same request key stock posting records one movement
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Один same-key movement не покрывает transfer/stocktake; расширить реальные команды и ledger baseline.

coreScenarios.expected: Reserved on hand ledger conserves quantities under concurrent checkout and reconciliation
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Отличать per-page REPEATABLE_READ и durable cursor от tenant-wide immutable snapshot; foreign/empty/end cases.

coreScenarios.expected: Published product QR remains stable and reflects authoritative offer price
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Стабильный reprint недостаточен; два revoke × checkout schedules и exact committed replay.

coreScenarios.expected: Hidden unpublished and revoked references never expose public card
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Старая привязка проверяет visibility без bytes; negative storage invocation и public derivative отделить от original.

coreScenarios.expected: Available/partial/unknown region preview including empty → advisory only
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Старая привязка к private order read не относится к regional advisory; проверить zero reservation и отсутствие warehouse leakage.

coreScenarios.expected: List price checkout requires active verified buyer and exact price/version
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Основной entrypoint checkoutVerified; email-first checkout по умолчанию закрыт; price race отдельно.

coreScenarios.expected: Buyer and seller alternate valid bargaining turns and persist agreement
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Добавить точную привязку reject, self-accept, request conflict и конкурентный revision CAS.

coreScenarios.expected: Accepted quote creates an immutable priced order with buyer identity
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Accepted happy path не доказывает разные ключи/namespace/restart; scope receipt tenant+key, quote uniqueness отдельно.

coreScenarios.expected: Expire/withdraw/revoke/suspend×checkout both orders, exact cutoff → winner only
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Pending proposal withdrawal versus accept+checkout, buyer suspension/deletion versus quote checkout, actual deadline crossing while PostgreSQL checkout waits, terminal proposal denial and exact replay implemented. Exact cutoff equality, live QR generation revocation semantics for already accepted quotes, persisted independent variant artifacts and new exact-SHA PostgreSQL execution remain open. No post-AGREED WITHDRAW transition exists under QR-04.

coreScenarios.expected: Order preparation requires full reserved pick before READY without stock debit
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Полный pick/ready/no early debit есть как кандидат; сохранить отдельный incomplete-pick отрицательный oracle.

coreScenarios.expected: Buyer issues credential; scoped staff previews; foreign/expired deny
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Старая привязка к preparation не доказывает issue/preview; wrong warehouse/expiry и zero IO/stock отдельно.

coreScenarios.expected: Only verified buyer can issue fresh one time pickup proof
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Issue-only не доказывает debit; reissue через issue с новым ключом; старый proof, replay и unique receipt.

coreScenarios.expected: Multiple simultaneous pickup scans produce one stock debit
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Двухпоточный scan не равен two-JVM; добавить revoke-first и handover-first, account и permission variants.

coreScenarios.expected: Crash after commit and lost response cannot cause second stock debit
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Реальные Runtime.halt workers существуют; отдельно SQL fault при receipt/credential и run logs с кодами выхода.

coreScenarios.expected: Return claims cannot exceed quantity in immutable completed handover
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Capacity учитывает все незакрытые claims кроме REJECTED/CANCELLED_BY_BUYER; проверить состояния и independent sum.

coreScenarios.expected: Only authorized staff reviews and approves return with durable evidence
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Review не равен physical reception; proof issue/consume, wrong warehouse, replay и no early stock.

coreScenarios.expected: Receipt inspection and restock link one returned quantity to one stock movement
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Связать RESTOCK movement по posting.movement_id; QUARANTINE отдельный ledger, WRITE_OFF без sellable credit.

coreScenarios.expected: Concurrent quarantine resolution in both orders → one resolution/conserved qty
coreScenarios.openRequirement: E.6C/v3 56/56 PASS and target/full/global evidence on d14234a5282f1ec625606e8b2b414256894fdeee. E.7A adds independent BSR §14.3 original posting, fulfilled capacity, intake and terminal movement/event linkage plus zero invoices at return checkpoints; v4 exact-SHA qualification pending. A/B/AB distinct-grant variant, inactive workspace denial, full checkpoint/variant manifest and independent review remain open. SUPPORTING_PARTIAL intentional.

coreScenarios.expected: Repeated physical returns cannot post a second restock movement
coreScenarios.openRequirement: Two-JVM duplicate не заменяет crash; добавить reception duplicate и исходный COMPLETED hash.

sectionObligations.statement: Catalog price revision does not silently update offer; explicit seller publication and price version.

Quantity conservation: available=on_hand-reserved for same tenant/location/SKU; reserve changes reserved only, fulfillment reduces on_hand and reserved by same quantity, release reduces reserved only.
STANDARD versus PICKUP_PROOF_REQUIRED immutable; generic fulfill denies proof-required order including replay; no cancellation after pick without approved reverse path.
Returns cannot exceed fulfilled quantity; only actual sellable RESTOCK posting increases sellable balance; quarantine/disposal not sellable.
Quantity qualification does not imply cost valuation or COGS; reservation never posts COGS.
Canonical physical facts use source UUID in same owner transaction; RESTOCK delegates to adjustment, no duplicate append; reserve/release, pick/ready and zero discrepancy not physical movement facts.
Transfer has two physical legs; tenant-wide net quantity zero only for matching same SKU/UOM transfer; no summing incompatible units.
Booked amount not revenue/payment; exact order/line/SKU identities; compatible currency/UOM and no fabricated allocation.
Return RESTOCK versus DISPOSE requires both real ordered races and independent physical lineage.

findings.issue: QR R1.4 is draft; email-first PLACED not equivalent to verified QR checkout
findings.resolution: Freeze QR J1 and DEC-FUL-01 prevail; preserve legacy distinct route, no email proof substitution.

findings.issue: QR draft BR-033 full active reserve does not alone prove full pick
findings.resolution: Freeze QR J1 and CORE-PICK-01 require full reserved pick before READY.

findings.issue: QR return draft uses WRITE_OFF while quarantine resolution review uses DISPOSE
findings.resolution: Map disposition vs resolution separately; do not rename enums or conflate stock movements. Check actual owner DDL.

findings.issue: Quantity R1 historical PASS not valuation qualification
findings.resolution: Keep cost policy metadata separate from executed valuation; no COGS inference.

findings.issue: BR-035 delegate and BR-044 no-show not automatically in scope
findings.resolution: Verified buyer only unless delegate explicitly admitted; no automatic reserve expiry or cancellation.

findings.issue: Physical movement vs sales lifecycle canonical facts
findings.resolution: No double append for return adjustment, no inventory fact from reserve/release or READY. Verify current producers and actual exact-SHA.
